title: geranium purpureum var. minutiflorum
intro: Geranium purpureum var. minutiflorum, commonly known as Dwarf Scarlet Geranium, is a small, flowering plant native to South Africa, belonging to the Geraniaceae family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving circulation, and alleviating symptoms of menopause. Therapeutically, it is said to exhibit expectorant, diuretic, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating respiratory issues, urinary problems, and skin conditions. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, tannins, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
